problem: Calculate the points where the hyperbola $9{y}^{2}-20{x}^{2}=180$ intersects the line $x=6.$
worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $x=6,$ we substitute $x=6$ into the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}9{y}^{2}-20{x}^{2} & =180 \\ 9{y}^{2}-20(6)^{2} & =180 \\ 9{y}^{2}-720 & =180 \\ {y}^{2}-80 & =20 \\ {y}^{2} & =80+20 \\ {y}^{2} & =100 \\ y & =\pm 10\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the hyperbola intersects the vertical line $x=6$  at the points $(6,\pm 10).$
